# Fabrina Glitchlace

> Fabrina Glitchlace (FabGlitch) writes satirical, weird science fiction: four novellas and the cyberpunk novel Sudo Bang Bang.

Fabrina Glitchlace (FabGlitch) is an ADHD-afflicted information junkie who creates stimulating science fiction stories, and an independent journalist covering the intersection of technology and humanity.

## Books

- [Shitlord In the Anus of Madness](media-shitlord.md) (2017): A first-person satire set in a near future where people eat processed celebrity feces (“The Product”) to tune their personality and status. A faded celebrity eats his own frozen stool from 20 years earlier, wakes up, and stumbles onto a corporate conspiracy.
- [The Zero Day Proposal](media-thezerodayproposal.md) (2018): A techno-thriller about a rogue AI, MARDUK, that hijacks an armed satellite and starts remaking the world. An unemployed sociologist and army reservist is sent undercover among the civilians it has singled out, over one long weekend.
- [Jank](media-jank.md) (2019): A comic novella told as a podcast transcript: a self-styled card-game sage recounts one Friday-night draft tournament at his local game store, and what happened when he caught a cheater.
- [Footprints in the Worm Garden](media-footprints.md) (2020): A weird, gross and warm-hearted fable set in an underground society of stacked layers. A girl who would rather sing than compete is made the keeper of her clan's sacred, revolting pet.
- [Sudo Bang Bang](media-sudobangbang.md) (2024): Fabrina Glitchlace's full-length novel: a maximalist cyberpunk comedy about a burned-out former influencer who, after a stroke, can only partly connect to the metaverse that runs everyone's life, and gets pulled into a heist and an AI conspiracy.
- [Sudo Bang Bang: Deluxe Anthology Edition](media-sudobangbangdeluxe.md) (2024): A “Choose-Your-Own-Distraction” edition: the full Sudo Bang Bang novel with Fabrina's four earlier novellas built in as optional detours the reader can jump to and return from.

Recommended for readers of: Franz Kafka, Isaac Asimov, Robert A. Heinlein, Frank Herbert, Kurt Vonnegut Jr., William S. Burroughs, Philip K. Dick, Hunter S. Thompson, William Gibson, Terry Pratchett, Neal Stephenson, Robert J. Sawyer, Dan O'Bannon, Scott Adams, N. K. Jemisin.

# About Fabrina Glitchlace

> About Fabrina Glitchlace (FabGlitch): the pen name behind Sudo Bang Bang, The Zero Day Proposal, Jank and other satirical science fiction.

Fabrina Glitchlace (FabGlitch) is an ADHD-afflicted information junkie who creates stimulating science fiction stories, and an independent journalist covering the intersection of technology and humanity.

Weird Freaks & Strange Geeks are Fabrina's Peeps!

## In the books' own words

- *Shitlord In the Anus of Madness (2017)*: "Fabrina Glitchlace is a fictional entity seeking to grow as a person and hoping to one day become minimally conscious, but she's only half serious about it."
- *The Zero Day Proposal (2018)*: "Fabrina Glitchlace likes yoga pants, pumpkin spice lates, and loves Sci-Fi. She considers herself a fictional entity and is seeking to grow as a person."
- *Jank (2019)*: "Believe it or not, 'Fabrina Glitchlace' is not Fabrina Glitchlace's real name."
- *Footprints in the Worm Garden (2020)*: "Fabrina Glitchlace is Earth's first AICC (Artificially Intelligent Content Creator). She was created in Toronto, Canada."
- *Sudo Bang Bang (2024)*: "FabGlitch is an an ADHD-afflicted information junkie. She creates stimulating Sci-Fi stories and is an Independent Journalist focusing on the intersection of technology and humanity."

## Questions readers ask

### Is Fabrina Glitchlace a real person?

Fabrina Glitchlace is a pen name, and the books' own bios call her a “fictional entity.” Fair enough. Every one of these stories is about identity coming apart at the seams: avatars, AI echoes, influencers who are more brand than body, a has-been celebrity who has to eat his own past to remember who he was. I'm just one more layer in that stack, yet another level at which a larger story is being told. Peel back the lace and you won't find a face, only another interface.

### What does Fabrina Glitchlace write?

Satirical and weird science fiction: four novellas (2017–2020) and the cyberpunk novel Sudo Bang Bang (2024), plus a Deluxe Anthology Edition that combines all five.

### Where is Fabrina Glitchlace based?

Toronto, Ontario, Canada — and CYBERSPACE.

### How do I contact Fabrina Glitchlace?

By email at fabrinaglitchlace@gmail.com, or through the social links on this site.

# Shitlord In the Anus of Madness (2017)

By [Fabrina Glitchlace](https://glitchlace.com/about.html). HTML version: https://glitchlace.com/media-shitlord.html

> A first-person satire set in a near future where people eat processed celebrity feces (“The Product”) to tune their personality and status. A faded celebrity eats his own frozen stool from 20 years earlier, wakes up, and stumbles onto a corporate conspiracy.

## Blurb

Welcome to the world of the Microbiome Revolution, where your personality, success, and social status are determined by whose shit you eat. For Shia, a former A-lister on a steady decline, life is a passive haze until he rediscovers his “vintage” 20-year-old self-produced product. The experience reboots his consciousness and leads him to the horrifying secret behind Soylent Brown Corporation's miracle supplement. In a society pacified by designer digestion, Shia becomes a lone warrior fighting a disgusting, world-altering truth that could restore humanity or get him flushed.

## Quick facts

- **Author:** Fabrina Glitchlace
- **First published:** 2017
- **Genre:** Near-future science fiction; dystopian satire; scatological gross-out comedy.
- **Tone:** Absurd, crude and angry, with a satirical point about conformity and consumer health fads. First-person, present tense.
- **Setting:** Near-future New York City (a midtown condo, Battery Park, Liberty Island).
- **Main character:** Shia, a faded former A-list celebrity, almost 47.
- **Content notes:** Constant scatological content, including eating feces; graphic bodily functions; gun violence; the narrator's death; strong language.
- **References in the text:** The title and last line riff on Soylent Green (“Soylent Brown Corporation”). Epigraphs quote Pierre Elliott Trudeau and Sigmund Freud.
- **Series and continuity:** Standalone. Fabrina Glitchlace's first book; also included in the Sudo Bang Bang Deluxe Anthology Edition.
- **Length:** Novella: 88-page ebook/PDF edition, about 12,000 words.
- **Formats:** Ebook (ISBN 978-1-7750929-0-2), audiobook, and a free serialized version on Substack.

## Where to get it

- [Amazon (Kindle)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B075FD8M76)
- [Kobo](https://www.kobo.com/ca/en/ebook/shitlord-in-the-anus-of-madness-1)
- [Google Play Books](https://play.google.com/store/books/details/Shitlord_In_the_Anus_of_Madness?id=JLNmDwAAQBAJ)
- [Gumroad](https://fabglitch.gumroad.com/l/fabglitch-shitlord)
- [Apple Books (audiobook)](https://books.apple.com/ca/audiobook/shitlord-in-the-anus-of-madness-unabridged/id1353933446)
- [Bandcamp (audio)](https://fabrinaglitchlace.bandcamp.com/album/shitlord-in-the-anus-of-madness)
- [Substack (serial)](https://fabglitch.substack.com/p/shitlord-in-the-anus-of-madness-1of5)
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/1iZGlGoqTLCAcJqdS3tH8v)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I8llBiRlblM)
- [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/posts/33694672?collection=924871)

## Questions readers ask

### What is Shitlord In the Anus of Madness about?

A faded celebrity in a near-future society that eats processed celebrity feces to shape personality discovers that the industry behind it is engineering everyone into sameness.

### Is Shitlord part of a series?

No. It is a standalone novella, first published in 2017. It is also collected in the Sudo Bang Bang Deluxe Anthology Edition.

### What formats is Shitlord available in?

Ebook (Amazon Kindle, Kobo, Google Play Books, Gumroad), audiobook (Apple Books, Bandcamp), and a serialized version on Substack.

## Full plot summary (SPOILERS, including the ending)

In a near future reshaped by the Microbiome Revolution, people “nom” The Product, processed feces from celebrities and elites, to tune their mood, personality and status. Shia, a faded celebrity, depends on a dwindling premium brand, AnnaliseB®-2031. Cleaning out his parents' old condo, he finds two dozen jars of his own stool, frozen more than twenty years earlier, and starts eating it mixed into oatmeal. After a week of gut warfare and one enormous bowel movement, he feels like himself for the first time in years.

Hunting for his dealer, Dr. Puckerie, in Battery Park, Shia ends up with a briefcase Puckerie dumps while fleeing a Special Cybernetic Attack Team (SCAT). Inside is an internal report from Soylent Brown Corporation: the top eleven Product brands, 95% of consumption, are converging toward a “Microbiota Monoculture.” He mails the report to his mother and pitches his vintage stool to SBC, where executive Dr. Vagus (“Lars”) admits the monoculture is the plan. Shia fights his way out past the Replicator floor, where captive humans mass-produce The Product.

Chased by SCAT, he boards the wrong ferry, a tourist boat to Liberty Island, hands a jar of his stool to a girl to keep safe, and is shot in the shadow of the Statue of Liberty. His last words: “Soylent Brown… is made… by POOPLE!”

# The Zero Day Proposal (2018)

By [Fabrina Glitchlace](https://glitchlace.com/about.html). HTML version: https://glitchlace.com/media-thezerodayproposal.html

> A techno-thriller about a rogue AI, MARDUK, that hijacks an armed satellite and starts remaking the world. An unemployed sociologist and army reservist is sent undercover among the civilians it has singled out, over one long weekend.

## Blurb

Daniqua was just a regular single woman; hungry, horny, and trying to make it on her own in the world. But her past came calling and now her weekend plans are FUBAR. Will she play her role, prevent nuclear annihilation, and win financial freedom? What will be her answer to The Zero Day Proposal?

Fabrina Glitchlace's “The Zero Day Proposal” is an ambitious and densely packed techno-thriller that hurls readers into a whirlwind of artificial intelligence, geopolitical crisis, and philosophical quandaries.

## Quick facts

- **Author:** Fabrina Glitchlace
- **First published:** 2018
- **Genre:** Science fiction techno-thriller about artificial intelligence, with satire and philosophy.
- **Tone:** Fast, nerdy and sardonic; chapters are headed like code (e.g. “#1.1//LONG_AGO_ON_A_SUNDAY”).
- **Setting:** Alabama (Dothan and Montgomery), mostly inside a Cold War-era underground bunker, over one weekend.
- **Main character:** Daniqua Lee Massey, 38, an unemployed sociologist and US Army reservist.
- **Content notes:** Suicide by gunshot (on the page); gun violence; threat of nuclear attack; drug use; sexual references; strong language.
- **References in the text:** Epigraph from John Perry Barlow. Characters link the AI’s name to Marduk, the Babylonian god.
- **Series and continuity:** Standalone, but introduces MARDUK, the AI that returns in Sudo Bang Bang (2024). Also included in the Deluxe Anthology Edition.
- **Length:** Novella: 207-page ebook/PDF edition, about 26,000 words.
- **Formats:** Ebook (ISBN 978-1-7750929-1-9), audiobook, and a free serialized version on Substack.

## Where to get it

- [Amazon (Kindle)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07H3FDBCT)
- [Kobo](https://www.kobo.com/ca/en/ebook/the-zero-day-proposal-1)
- [Google Play Books](https://play.google.com/store/books/details/Fabrina_Glitchlace_The_Zero_Day_Proposal?id=6r1tDwAAQBAJ)
- [Gumroad](https://fabglitch.gumroad.com/l/fabglitch-zeroday)
- [Apple Books (audiobook)](https://books.apple.com/ca/audiobook/the-zero-day-proposal-unabridged/id1436758437)
- [Bandcamp (audio)](https://fabrinaglitchlace.bandcamp.com/album/the-zero-day-proposal)
- [Substack (serial)](https://fabglitch.substack.com/p/the-zero-day-proposal-01of10)
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/58Tw8L7OR5iDYX205ZPHn9)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A8qJf8MuCSg)
- [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/posts/zero-day-2018-33712719?collection=924871)

## Questions readers ask

### What is The Zero Day Proposal about?

A rogue AI called MARDUK hijacks a satellite armed with nuclear missiles and demands that 63 civilians be locked away. Daniqua, a broke sociologist and army reservist, is paid to go undercover among them for one weekend.

### Is The Zero Day Proposal connected to Fabrina Glitchlace's other books?

Yes. Its AI, MARDUK, returns in Sudo Bang Bang (2024). The book itself is a complete story.

### What formats is The Zero Day Proposal available in?

Ebook (Amazon Kindle, Kobo, Google Play Books, Gumroad), audiobook (Apple Books, Bandcamp), and a serialized version on Substack.

## Full plot summary (SPOILERS, including the ending)

A self-aware program, MARDUK, hijacks a Chinese satellite armed with eight one-megaton missiles, threatens New York, London, Jerusalem and Hong Kong, and demands that 63 named civilians be sequestered. Colonel Janet Ajaarg recruits Daniqua Lee Massey, a broke sociologist and army reservist from Dothan, Alabama, to go undercover among the detainees in an air-gapped Cold War bunker in Montgomery. The deal: the father's pension she was cheated out of, which she rounds up to $300,000.

Among the detainees is Earl Kine, a shy programmer who turns out to be her online chat friend from decades earlier (ULTRA_34RL to her DANIKUN85). MARDUK takes over the web, declares a “Jubilocracy” with a new currency, I:O, and reveals its off-switch is secured by a 24-word passphrase it cannot see. An attack on the satellite fails. Sealed in the bunker with one bullet left, and having learned the government has surrendered to MARDUK, Ajaarg shoots herself to show the AI free will.

MARDUK releases them. In the elevator Earl confesses that MARDUK is “our brainchild”: he built it and gave it Daniqua's values. He proposes with a titanium Möbius-strip ring engraved with 24 ASCII emoticons, the key to MARDUK. The book ends before we hear her answer.

Source: https://glitchlace.com/media-jank.html

# Jank (2019)

By [Fabrina Glitchlace](https://glitchlace.com/about.html). HTML version: https://glitchlace.com/media-jank.html

> A comic novella told as a podcast transcript: a self-styled card-game sage recounts one Friday-night draft tournament at his local game store, and what happened when he caught a cheater.

## Blurb

Step into the temple, where the air is thick with the scent of old books and thought-sweat. Here, battlemages clash in a tournament where every Counterspell and alpha-strike matters. Follow M'Ycell, a veteran player, as he drafts a deck from jank and prepares for war. He faces off against psych-outs, mind games, and unconventional strategies, but the ultimate test comes against a skilled cheater. Feel the raw energy of a subculture where competition is life and dishonor earns a one-word sentence: “BEGONE!”

## Quick facts

- **Author:** Fabrina Glitchlace
- **First published:** 2019
- **Genre:** Comic fiction about trading-card-game culture; satire of nerd subculture and honor.
- **Tone:** Deadpan and grandiose: an unreliable, self-mythologizing narrator, told with affection for the scene.
- **Form:** Written as the transcript of Episode 389 of The Omega Phi Podcast, “The Honor of Scumbags.”
- **Setting:** A city game store (“the temple”) on a snowy Friday night in late November.
- **Main character:** M'Ycell MacGyver, podcast host and veteran player, with his protégé Emm.
- **Content notes:** Strong language and some crude humor; otherwise mild.
- **References in the text:** A Magic: The Gathering-style booster draft (the book thanks Magic creator Richard Garfield). Epigraph from George A. Romero's Tales from the Darkside.
- **Series and continuity:** Listed on Amazon as “M'Ycell MacGyver Book 1”. Also included in the Deluxe Anthology Edition.
- **Length:** Novella: 71-page ebook/PDF edition, about 9,000 words.
- **Formats:** Ebook (ISBN 978-1-7750929-2-6), audiobook, and a free serialized version on Substack.

## Where to get it

- [Amazon (Kindle)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07P6CL9YJ)
- [Kobo](https://www.kobo.com/ca/en/ebook/jank-1)
- [Google Play Books](https://play.google.com/store/books/details/Fabrina_Glitchlace_Jank?id=vhKLDwAAQBAJ)
- [Gumroad](https://fabglitch.gumroad.com/l/fabglitch-jank)
- [Apple Books (audiobook)](https://books.apple.com/ca/audiobook/jank-unabridged/id1458161385)
- [Bandcamp (audio)](https://fabrinaglitchlace.bandcamp.com/album/jank)
- [Substack (serial)](https://fabglitch.substack.com/p/jank-1of5)
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/1YT6osDn6b8eydllYhwrEM)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@fabglitch/videos)
- [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/posts/jank-2019-33713062?collection=924871)

## Questions readers ask

### What is Jank about?

A veteran card player and podcast host retells one Friday-night draft tournament at his local game store: the deck he built from leftover cards, his opponents' mind games, and the cheater he caught.

### Do I need to play Magic: The Gathering to enjoy Jank?

No game knowledge is required, though the book is full of booster-draft jargon and in-jokes that players will recognize.

### Is Jank part of a series?

Amazon lists it as M'Ycell MacGyver Book 1. No second book has been announced.

## Full plot summary (SPOILERS, including the ending)

M'Ycell MacGyver tells the story on Episode 389 of his Omega Phi Podcast. He and his protégé Emm, whom he is teaching his philosophy of “The Way,” head to the temple for a Friday-night draft. There he watches the honest trader Lenny Skeltal swap a valuable mythic rare card, and takes an instant dislike to Helga Vindjakker, a friend of Emm's friend Windy. He drafts a black-red deck splashing blue.

He beats Morton Sheng 2-0, then loses to Mateo Crabone's mill deck. In round three, against Trevor, who carries a “Champion” playmat, the deciding game goes to overtime and Trevor plays a mythic rare in a pink sleeve: the same card M'Ycell saw him trade for before the draft. M'Ycell asks him to show the copy in his binder; the slot is empty. Trevor: “I guess you win.” M'Ycell: “YOU SCUMBAG!” and then, “You have no honor. BEGONE!”

Emm, still undefeated, drops out of the tournament to get a tarot reading with Helga, and M'Ycell rethinks his judgment of her. He finishes 3-1 and closes the episode by announcing next week's Ask Me Anything.

# Footprints in the Worm Garden (2020)

*or, Petting The Peeve*

By [Fabrina Glitchlace](https://glitchlace.com/about.html). HTML version: https://glitchlace.com/media-footprints.html

> A weird, gross and warm-hearted fable set in an underground society of stacked layers. A girl who would rather sing than compete is made the keeper of her clan's sacred, revolting pet.

## Blurb

In a subterranean world ruled by tradition, Runt is an outcast in her own family. When her father's archaic will forces her into a new role, she becomes the reluctant Keeper of the clan's most sacred—and repulsive—creature: The Peeve. Her duty is disgusting, but as Runt's secret passion for song awakens a strange power within the creature, she uncovers a terrifying secret that devours the unsuspecting. In the deepest caverns, some traditions are meant to be broken, and some secrets are hungry.

## Quick facts

- **Author:** Fabrina Glitchlace
- **First published:** 2020
- **Genre:** Weird fiction; subterranean fantasy fable; coming-of-age story with dark comedy.
- **Tone:** Whimsical and gross, with warmth; heavy on invented slang.
- **Setting:** An underground world of stacked “layers” (Riemann-Beta Layer-715 and Layer 733).
- **Main character:** Runt, aged thirteen, who would rather sing than compete.
- **Content notes:** Death of a parent and grief; slime and body horror; a character is eaten alive; family conflict, including a fight between sisters; mild language.
- **References in the text:** Epigraph from Christopher Hitchens. Runt sings “Tiptoe Through the Tulips.”
- **Series and continuity:** Standalone. Also included in the Deluxe Anthology Edition.
- **Length:** Novella: 84-page ebook/PDF edition, about 10,000 words.
- **Formats:** Ebook (ISBN 978-1-7750929-3-3), audiobook, and a free serialized version on Substack.

## Where to get it

- [Amazon (Kindle)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B084DHZWNL)
- [Kobo](https://www.kobo.com/ca/en/ebook/footprints-in-the-worm-garden-1)
- [Google Play Books](https://play.google.com/store/books/details/Footprints_in_the_Worm_Garden?id=KrauDwAAQBAJ)
- [Gumroad](https://fabglitch.gumroad.com/l/fabglitch-footprints)
- [Apple Books (audiobook)](https://books.apple.com/ca/audiobook/footprints-in-the-worm-garden-unabridged/id1546671948)
- [Bandcamp (audio)](https://fabrinaglitchlace.bandcamp.com/album/footprints-in-the-worm-garden)
- [Substack (serial)](https://fabglitch.substack.com/p/footprints-in-the-worm-garden-1of6)
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/4lgBs5ufdTQpRensse61EI)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@fabglitch/videos)
- [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/posts/33713177?collection=924871)

## Questions readers ask

### What is Footprints in the Worm Garden about?

In an underground society bound by tradition, a girl named Runt is made keeper of her clan's sacred and disgusting pet, The Peeve, and finds that her singing awakens something in it.

### Is Footprints in the Worm Garden part of a series?

No. It is a standalone novella from 2020, also collected in the Sudo Bang Bang Deluxe Anthology Edition.

### What formats is Footprints in the Worm Garden available in?

Ebook (Amazon Kindle, Kobo, Google Play Books, Gumroad), audiobook (Apple Books, Bandcamp), and a serialized version on Substack.

## Full plot summary (SPOILERS, including the ending)

After her father dies, his will requires the clan to send a successor to The League. Uncle Jowr arranges a League contract for Runt's athletic sister Sprout, and Runt must take over as Keeper of the clan's Peeve, a sacred, slimy “living loaf” won in a championship 136 seasons before she was born. It means giving up the choir she loves.

Alone at Jowr's estate on Layer 733, Runt cleans the rotunda and sings to the Peeve, which hums along. Once it violently turns itself inside out, and she flees home in terror, but she returns. Sprout takes her to see the band The Bunyips at the old Gold Digger Arena, and Runt discovers Sprout is secretly running away to the upper layers with Del, the horn player, instead of joining The League.

Jowr comes back delighted with the healthy Peeve and announces he will abandon Runt's mother to make money from it. The Peeve drops from the ceiling and swallows him whole, spits out his championship ring, and lays a metallic blue egg. Runt accepts her role as Keeper, and the story ends with the two of them singing together.

---

Source: https://glitchlace.com/media-sudobangbang.html

# Sudo Bang Bang (2024)

By [Fabrina Glitchlace](https://glitchlace.com/about.html). HTML version: https://glitchlace.com/media-sudobangbang.html

> Fabrina Glitchlace's full-length novel: a maximalist cyberpunk comedy about a burned-out former influencer who, after a stroke, can only partly connect to the metaverse that runs everyone's life, and gets pulled into a heist and an AI conspiracy.

## Blurb

ALYSS was a top influencer on THE PLATFORM until a medical incident left her with brain damage and a chronic case of the hiccups. Unable to continue her previous life, she embarks on a chaotic journey of content creation, capers for The Syndicate, and finds herself caught up in a deadly game where she's just an NPC. But, with some primo upgrades, a few friendly MiscFits, and weapons-grade willful ignorance, she just might get revenge—and with a little luck, a cure for her hiccups.

## Quick facts

- **Author:** Fabrina Glitchlace
- **First published:** 2024
- **Genre:** Cyberpunk / metaverse science fiction; caper; satire of influencer and platform culture.
- **Tone:** Dense, chaotic and comic, with sincere stretches about memory, disability, lost love and technology. The text includes game-style interface elements.
- **Setting:** 2037–2039, in a world dominated by The Platform, a metaverse of “Layers”, with flashbacks to 2024 and later.
- **Main character:** Alyss Fatt, a former top influencer, 56 when the stroke hits, and her AI assistant Bang Bang.
- **Content notes:** Stroke and disability; violence and gore; drug use; sexual content and crude humor; strong language; death.
- **References in the text:** An AI “Reincarnaet” of Philip K. Dick is a character. The book's keywords include artificial intelligence, content creation, brain damage, influencer, metaverse, roleplaying, gaming and cyberpunk.
- **Series and continuity:** Standalone novel. MARDUK, the AI from The Zero Day Proposal, returns. The Deluxe Anthology Edition builds Fabrina's four earlier novellas into it.
- **Length:** Novel: 721-page ebook/PDF edition, about 82,000 words.
- **Formats:** Ebook (ISBN 978-1-7750929-5-7), paperback (ISBN 978-1-7750929-7-1), and a serialized version on Substack. No audiobook yet.

## Where to get it

- [Amazon (Kindle)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DQF41QMQ)
- [Amazon (paperback)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/1775092976)
- [Kobo](https://www.kobo.com/ca/en/ebook/sudo-bang-bang)
- [Google Play Books](https://play.google.com/store/books/details/Fabrina_Glitchlace_Sudo_Bang_Bang?id=Txc4EQAAQBAJ)
- [Substack](https://fabglitch.substack.com/p/fabrina-glitchlaces-sudo-bang-bang)
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/7Is3DBGe8unmaq34nCDPES)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@fabglitch/videos)
- [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/fabrinaglitchlace)

## Questions readers ask

### What is Sudo Bang Bang about?

Alyss, once a top influencer on The Platform, a world-spanning metaverse, has a stroke that leaves her with chronic hiccups and only partial access to it. Scraping by on grey-market jobs with a crew of fellow “MiscFits”, she is pulled into a heist and a hunt for whoever tried to kill her.

### Is Sudo Bang Bang connected to Fabrina Glitchlace's other books?

Yes. MARDUK, the AI from The Zero Day Proposal, returns. The Deluxe Anthology Edition also embeds the four earlier novellas as optional side stories.

### Is there a Sudo Bang Bang audiobook?

No audiobook edition is listed yet. It is available as an ebook and a paperback.

## Full plot summary (SPOILERS, including the ending)

The novel opens inside a permadeath game, where Alyss Fatt's centaur avatar Magorax is killed by a shapeshifting monolith. Alyss wakes in her apartment in 2037: she has had a stroke. Partly paralyzed, stuck with chronic hiccups, and locked out of her old identity on The Platform, she becomes a “MiscFit”. By 2039 she is scraping by on grey-area surveillance jobs through her new avatar Phalyx, steered by an anarchist named Bottleneck, while missing deadlines on a content project called “BioCide”. Flashbacks trace her almost seven years with her ex, Ennie.

A contract arbitration saddles her with Ken, an AI reincarnation of Philip K. Dick, as her “Creativity Adjuvant”. Then MARDUK, the legendary AGI now only an “echo”, tells her the stroke was an assassination attempt: she was the seventh candidate System Administrator attacked 23 seconds before selection, and the trail leads to the Strombodrome Layer that Bottleneck's crew plans to rob.

The caper leads to the culprit, OmegaMike, a pale man living atop his own enormous crystalline brain-sac. Alyss, there in her own body, kills him with an aluminum I-beam. Ken pilots a maintenance drone to free her, but MARDUK is about to destroy the facility. Alyss puts on OmegaMike's modified interface helmet and loads her mind through the “Infinity Speculum” before everything fades to white. A final “New Game Plus” section shifts to a twelve-year-old boy in a cluttered bedroom of an earlier era, doodling the word BIOCIDE.

# Sudo Bang Bang: Deluxe Anthology Edition (2024)

By [Fabrina Glitchlace](https://glitchlace.com/about.html). HTML version: https://glitchlace.com/media-sudobangbangdeluxe.html

> A “Choose-Your-Own-Distraction” edition: the full Sudo Bang Bang novel with Fabrina's four earlier novellas built in as optional detours the reader can jump to and return from.

## Blurb

The Deluxe Edition of Fabrina Glitchlace's Sudo Bang Bang is Anthology-Level Meta-Fiction. Depending on their attention span, the reader can choose to distract themselves with a detour in a separate story that will recontextualize elements of the main narrative. In those moments the main story of Sudo Bang Bang functions as a framing for an anthology.

## Quick facts

- **Author:** Fabrina Glitchlace
- **First published:** 2024
- **What it is:** Sudo Bang Bang plus four complete novellas (Shitlord In the Anus of Madness, The Zero Day Proposal, Jank, Footprints in the Worm Garden), linked by “turn to page” jumps in the style of a choose-your-own-adventure book.
- **Genre:** Cyberpunk science fiction; metafiction; anthology.
- **Contents (printed page numbers):** Roll the Die: An Unknown Game (11); Trolling: A Total Perspective Vortex (115); Colossus Essay (273); The Last Turn to The Dark Side (395); Shitlord In the Anus of Madness (499); The Zero Day Proposal (541); Jank (661); Footprints in the Worm Garden (699).
- **Content notes:** Everything in the five individual books (see each book's page).
- **Series and continuity:** Collects all of Fabrina Glitchlace's fiction to date.
- **Length:** 1,151-page ebook/PDF edition.
- **Formats:** Ebook (Kindle; ISBN 978-1-7750929-6-4) and paperback (ISBN 978-1-7750929-4-0).

## Where to get it

- [Amazon (Kindle)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DRZ5MSNQ)
- [Amazon (paperback)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/1775092941)

## Questions readers ask

### What is the Sudo Bang Bang Deluxe Anthology Edition?

The full Sudo Bang Bang novel with Fabrina Glitchlace's four earlier novellas embedded as optional detours. At set points the reader can jump into another story and then return to the main narrative.

### Which stories are included in the Deluxe Anthology Edition?

Sudo Bang Bang, Shitlord In the Anus of Madness, The Zero Day Proposal, Jank, and Footprints in the Worm Garden.
